extensions.name: MangaDex
extensions.note: runtime-audit 2026-05-10: RUNTIME-OK. API v5 stable, search + chapters verified.

extensions.name: WeebCentral
extensions.note: v6 fix 2026-08-10 (Yan bug report 'extension morte'): le site est passe aux liens RELATIFS. /hot-updates et /series/<ULID>/full-chapter-list servent href='/series/...' et href='/chapters/...' au lieu de href='https://weebcentral.com/...'. Migration PARTIELLE: /search/data rend encore de l'absolu. Toutes les regex d'href etaient ancrees sur la forme absolue -> 0 match sur listing ET liste de chapitres, sans exception levee (le site repond 200). Fix: prefixe d'hote optionnel via hrefPattern(), normalisation en ABSOLU via absoluteUrl() (le relatif orphelinerait les telechargements et la progression deja indexes par URL absolue). Runtime verifie: v5 list=0/chapters=0 -> v6 list=60/chapters=194/pages=84.

extensions.name: MangaRead
extensions.note: v5: extractChapNum now uses URL slug as authoritative fallback. Harness reported 3864/3864 chapters with number==0 (Martial Peak, non-standard title names). URL /chapter-N/ always encodes the number. Decimal: /chapter-12-5/ -> 12.5. Oneshot: 0. v4: itemPattern {0,5000} cover fix. v3: chapter shape. v2: imageUrl. v1: port from Mangayomi.

extensions.name: Webtoons
extensions.note: v3 (round 4 fix 2026-05-10): dropped alt='[^]*' requirement from primary parse pattern. Live DOM has alt='' on all series imgs which broke v2 regex. Fix verified: 143 series parsed.

extensions.name: Asura Scans
extensions.note: v6: QuickJS compat fix — replaced /s dotAll regexes with [\s\S] in getMangaDetail (title/img/desc/status/author) and getChapterList. The /s flag is unsupported in Flutter QuickJS runtime, causing blank detail pages.

extensions.name: Mangas Origines
extensions.note: v5 2026-08-10 REECRITURE COMPLETE: le site a ete refondu (theme maison 'ori-*'), les selecteurs Madara des v1-v4 ne matchent plus rien - manga__item, summary_image, wp-manga-chapter: 0 occurrence; base des permaliens passee de /catalogues/<slug>/ a /oeuvre/<slug>/; admin-ajax manga_get_chapters repond 400. CAUSE EXACTE de la liste vide sans exception: v4 interrogeait deja le bon endpoint POST {url}/ajax/chapters mais gardait le test indexOf('wp-manga-chapter') - absent de la reponse du nouveau theme, donc reponse correcte rejetee puis repli sur un HTML sans chapitre = []. FIX: catalogue/recherche via POST admin-ajax action=madara_child_catalogue (JSON html+more+total, tri/statut/origine/genres, 30/page) avec repli SSR sur /catalogues/ et /?s=..&post_type=wp-manga; cartes a.ori-cat-card; detail via h1.ori-sr-title + .ori-sr-cover + .ori-sr-syn-texte + a.ori-sr-genre + .ori-sr-signature + .ori-sr-badge-statut; chapitres via POST /oeuvre/<slug>/ajax/chapters puis div.ori-chl-row (le GET ne rend aucune ligne, la liste est injectee en JS); pages inchangees en div.page-break img (le lecteur est reste Madara) avec ?style=list obligatoire pour les oeuvres en mode paged. URLs de chapitre TOUJOURS absolues; les URLs d'entree en base historique (/catalogues/, /manga/) sont normalisees vers /oeuvre/ sinon l'endpoint chapitres repond 404 pour toute oeuvre deja en bibliotheque. VERIFIE EN DIRECT sur le HTML reellement servi (navigateur passe par Cloudflare): 6/6 methodes vertes, 20 oeuvres, 7018 chapitres, 0 date non parsee, 0 URL non absolue. ATTENTION MIGRATION: les chapitres telecharges avant la refonte sont indexes sous /catalogues/<slug>/chapitre-N/ (URL desormais 404) et ne seront pas reconnus par les nouvelles URLs /oeuvre/<slug>/chapitre-N/.

extensions.name: PantheonScan
extensions.note: v2.1: scheme validation + ReDoS pre-slicing. imageUrl/chapUrl reject non-http(s) schemes. getMangaDetail anchors each dotAll pattern to a 3-10KB window to prevent backtracking on 300KB+ Madara pages.

extensions.name: MangaPill
extensions.note: runtime-audit 2026-05-10: RUNTIME-EMPTY. HTTP 200 + CF-RAY. No JS framework (not Next/React/Vue). Homepage returns 0 manga item refs from static HTML. Cause: content loaded via JS after page render (client-side AJAX or defer). Selector-based extension cannot extract items without JS execution.

extensions.name: Flame Comics
extensions.note: v2 (round 4 fix 2026-05-10): _extractAllSeries switched from regex with [^\[\]] character class to JSON.parse on __NEXT_DATA__ script tag. Previous regex broke on nested arrays (tags:[]). Fix verified: 153 series parsed via pageProps.series. Effie hardening: 2MB cap on JSON.parse + series_id /^\d+$/ validation against CDN path traversal.

extensions.name: MangaHere
extensions.note: chapter-list fix 2026-08-17: getChapterList isolates the detail-main-list container and splits per <li> before matching. The old pattern let a lazy gap cross element boundaries, so the top read-first/last shortcut href paired with the newest chapter's label: c001 was numbered 156 and the real c156 entry was swallowed (155 of 156 returned). Verified live on 3 works: god_slayer 155->156, onepunch_man 417->418, martial_master 548->549; first entry correctly paired in each.
